messages:
joe-sales: Hey team — Acme Health wants to kick off a 2-week POC. They need hosted API keys for quick integration and a Dedicated pool to validate latency under load. Security questionnaire says VPC peering or Private deployment is a hard requirement. Also asking about least-privilege invites for their dev + infra folks.

alice-eng: Thanks for the context. Is the Dedicated pool needed immediately or can we start on hosted and spin up Dedicated mid-POC?

joe-sales: Prefer to start hosted to unblock app dev, but they want a plan and timeline for Dedicated + VPC so legal can sign.

ben-infra: Hosted first is fine. For Dedicated + VPC we need a provisioning request — ETA ~10 business days for standard Dedicated in our EU region, + VPC peering/setup depending on customer networking (usually 5-7 days after network team coordinates).

carla-sec: For the security questionnaire: we can offer Hosted with contract addenda + SOC reports while we negotiate Private. For VPC, we'll require a CIDR range and contact for their netops. Also confirm KMS/HSM requirements.

evelyn-ps: For RBAC, recommend creating a workspace for the POC and invite users with least privilege: roles = [viewer, deployer, admin]. Give devs viewer+api-key dev role, infra gets deployer. We can create a temporary service-account key for CI.

provisioning-bot: Note: new request template -> /internal/provisioning/dedicated-request. Fill region, expected RPS, max seq len, initial replicas.

alice-eng: Quick checklist I usually send to customers: 1) Start hosted with ephemeral API key, 2) Create workspace + invite via email, 3) Provide list of users + desired roles, 4) Send network CIDR + VPN/peering contact if Private, 5) Confirm data handling (logs storage/retention). Want me to paste as message to Acme?

joe-sales: Yes please paste + include rough pricing band for Dedicated and Managed VPC add-on. They asked about cost upfront.

ben-infra: Pricing band: Dedicated baseline starts at ~$15k/mo for the smallest pool (EU) — depends on GPUs and committed throughput. Managed VPC add-on is usually an extra one-time setup + monthly network egress fees; I'll follow up with a tighter estimate once they provide expected throughput.

carla-sec: On RBAC: here's a minimal policy we can apply to devs (pseudo):
```
role: poc_dev
permissions:
  - model:read
  - inference:invoke
  - keys:create: false
  - workspace:read
```
Set service account with keys:create for CI only and rotate after POC.

evelyn-ps: Also ask if they want SSO (SAML/SCIM). If yes, we can provision invites as SSO-only and avoid manual invites. SCIM automation takes ~3 days to enable.

joe-sales: Great. I'll send hosted keys to their devs and the checklist. Can someone own the Dedicated request ticket once they confirm region?

ben-infra: I can own it. Ticket will include a short network worksheet. ping me with contact.

carla-sec: I'll draft the security questionnaire answers for Hosted + Dedicated sections and attach SOC/ISO docs.

alice-eng: I'll DM the checklist + sample least-privilege policy to joe to forward. Also include a short sample curl snippet for ephemeral key usage:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

joe-sales: Perfect. I'll send to Acme and update this thread with the region and their network contact. :thumbsup:

provisioning-bot: Reminder: include expected seq_len and qps when submitting dedicated-request form to speed provisioning.

joe-sales: Updated — customer will start on hosted, region EU-west1, netops contact is nets@acmehealth.com. Ben, tagging you to start the Dedicated request.

ben-infra: Got it, starting ticket now. Will post ticket ID here when created.

carla-sec: I'll attach security docs to the ticket.

joe-sales: Thanks everyone — moving to email thread with Acme, will CC infra + sec.
